# Chibi Ludo 3D

> A free, anime-inspired 3D Ludo board game by Inkfinity Studio. Playable instantly in any browser with zero download required.

- **URL**: https://ludo.inkfinitystudio.store/
- **Publisher**: Inkfinity Studio (https://inkfinitystudio.store)
- **Contact**: support@inkfinitystudio.store

## Key Features & Benefits
- **100% Free & No Download**: Runs directly in the browser (or as a lightweight PWA), saving device storage space.
- **Full 3D & Animations**: Interactive 3D board, 3D dice physics, and animated chibi animal tokens.
- **Free Voice Chat**: Built-in voice chat to talk with friends during matches at no cost.
- **GIFs & Emotes**: Send GIFs and reaction emotes in real-time multiplayer.
- **Play With Friends or AI**: Private 9-digit online multiplayer rooms, local Pass & Play, or Solo vs smart AI bots.

## Core Rules
- **Spawn on 6**: Roll a 6 to move a token from your yard onto the track.
- **Extra Turns**: Rolling a 6 or capturing an opponent token grants a bonus roll.
- **Safe Stars**: Tokens on star tiles cannot be captured.
- **Win Condition**: First player to get all tokens to the center Home wins.
